launcher.notes: Crash Intelligence: when the game crashes, the launcher reads the crash report it wrote, shows the real cause in plain language on the home screen, and auto-fixes known crash classes (heap up, direct buffer memory, duplicate mods, OptiFine/client parked to safe mode, natives relink, audio/GL) with up to 3 smart restarts. Crash protection card in Settings; diagnosis survives launcher restarts.

notes: Launcher v2.4.9: Crash Intelligence — real crash causes + auto-fix + safe mode. Client v2.9.18 unchanged.
